detail.longDescription: Cairn OBS is live: Kubernetes-native log aggregation and observability. One query language over two engines — pipe syntax over ClickHouse, full-text over embedded Tantivy, same execution plan. Dashboards, alerting, a statically linked Rust agent, multi-tenant RBAC + SSO, self-hosted AI query assist via Ollama. AGPLv3, the whole thing. No open core, no carve-out, nothing held back for a paid tier that doesn't exist. https:// linuxexpert.org/announcing-cai rn-obs/ # Kubernetes # Observability # SRE # AGPL
